info.title: AutoCanvas API
info.description: HTTP API of the AutoCanvas server. Conventions: https://bexy315.github.io/autocanvas/technical/api

get.description: Product name and version. Needs no authentication, so clients can check that they talk to an AutoCanvas server.

Users (not disabled) whose user name or display name contains `query`, and groups whose name does, ignoring case; names that start with it first, at most 20 of each. Needs at least 2 characters. Names only, never e-mail addresses. Everyone signed in may search, to share folders.
Every node type a step can use with `type:`, with the inputs it takes under `with` and the outputs it sets. Files using any other type are refused.

Every recorded change, newest first, one page at a time. Admins only. Filters: `from` and `to` (date and time, `to` exclusive), `action` (exact, or a prefix ending in `*` such as `folder.*`), `actorId`, `targetType`, `targetId`.

Changes in the folder and in the folders below it that the caller owns too, newest first. Needs Owner. Filters: `from` and `to` (date and time, `to` exclusive), `action` (exact, or a prefix ending in `*` such as `folder.*`), `actorId`, `targetType`, `targetId`.

post.summary: Start a run through a webhook address
post.description: Needs no sign-in: the token in the path is the credential. The body (at most 1 MiB), the headers and the query become `trigger.body`, `trigger.headers` and `trigger.query`; a JSON body can be read into, as `trigger.body.NAME`. A signed address needs `X-AutoCanvas-Signature: sha256=<hex HMAC-SHA256 of the body>`.

Checks user name and password and sets the session cookie. Every failure gives the same answer. Too many failures for a name lock it for 15 minutes; too many attempts from one address are refused with 429.
Ends the current session and removes the cookie.
Ends every session of the signed-in user, on all devices.

get.description: The account with its groups. Also works while the password must be changed, so clients can show that.

put.description: Needs the current password and a session (not an API token). Ends every other session of the user.

get.description: Where the user is signed in, newest first; the current session is marked.
Newest first, without the secrets. Needs a session: a token cannot manage tokens.

post.description: The answer contains the secret once; store it right away. Send it as 'Authorization: Bearer acp_…'. Needs a session.

delete.summary: Delete one of my API tokens
delete.description: Requests with the token fail from now on. Needs a session.

get.description: Ordered by user name, one page at a time (see API conventions: paging).

post.description: The user must change the given password at the first sign-in.

patch.description: Display name, e-mail, admin and disabled. The last enabled admin cannot be demoted or disabled (409).

delete.description: Removes the account with its sessions, tokens and memberships; the audit log keeps the name. Not the last enabled admin (409).

post.description: The user must change it at the next sign-in; their sessions end.

get.description: Newest first, without the secrets.

delete.description: For example when a token has leaked. Requests with it fail from now on.

get.description: Ordered by name with member counts, one page at a time (see API conventions: paging).

get.summary: Get a group with its members

delete.description: Removes the group and its memberships; the users stay.

put.summary: Add a user to a group
put.description: Adding a member twice changes nothing.

delete.summary: Remove a user from a group

get.description: The topmost folders the caller may view, each with the names of the folders above it. For admins: the top-level folders.

post.description: At the top level anyone may create a folder and becomes its Owner; a subfolder needs Editor on the parent and inherits from it.

get.description: With the caller's role and the folders above it. The ETag header is the folder's version, for If-Match.

patch.description: Needs Editor. Send If-Match with the ETag to avoid overwriting someone else's change (412).

delete.description: Needs Owner, and the folder must be empty (409 otherwise). Its grants go with it.

get.description: Ordered by name, one page at a time. Restricted subfolders appear only to callers with a role on them.

post.description: With everything below it. Needs Editor on the folder and on the new parent, or Owner to move it to the top level. Rights change with the place.

put.summary: Restrict a folder or lift that
put.description: Needs Owner. In a restricted folder, grants from above no longer apply; the caller keeps access through an explicit Owner grant.

get.summary: List the grants on a folder
get.description: Roles given directly on this folder, users first. Needs Owner.

put.summary: Grant a role on a folder
put.description: To a user or a group; replaces the role they had on this folder. Needs Owner.

delete.description: Needs Owner. Removing your own Owner grant can lock you out; an admin can repair that.

get.summary: List the automations in a folder
get.description: Ordered by name, one page at a time. Needs Viewer on the folder; subfolders are listed separately.

post.description: Saves the file as version 1. Needs Editor on the folder. An invalid file is refused with every problem in `diagnostics`.

post.summary: Check an automation file without saving it
post.description: Runs the checks a save runs, in the given folder: the file, its node types and its triggers. Answers 200 with every error and warning, also when the file is invalid; `valid` says whether a save would accept it. Needs Viewer on the folder.

get.description: With the file of the current version, its warnings and the caller's role. The ETag header is the version number, for If-Match.

put.description: Needs Editor. The file must be valid (else `diagnostics` lists every problem) and differ from the current version. Send If-Match with the ETag to avoid overwriting someone else's change (412).

patch.description: Changes its key in the folder; the versions stay. Needs Editor.

delete.description: With all its versions; this cannot be undone. Needs Editor. The audit log keeps who deleted what.

get.description: The current version exactly as saved, as `text/yaml` with the automation's name as file name.
From its current version: whether it starts by hand or by webhook, its schedule entries with when each fires next, and the automation it follows. Needs Viewer.

post.summary: Move an automation to another folder
post.description: Needs Editor on both folders, and the name must be free in the new one. Rights change with the place.

get.summary: List the versions of an automation
get.description: Newest first, one page at a time, with message and author.

get.summary: Get one version of an automation
get.description: With its file. To restore it, save that file again as a new version.
By name; everyone signed in reads them with their values; only admins change them.

put.description: Creates it (201) or replaces its value (200); names are unique regardless of case. Everyone signed in reads them with their values; only admins change them.

get.description: Names only, by name; everyone signed in sees their names; only admins change them. Secret values are never returned.

put.description: Creates it (201) or replaces its value (200). The value is encrypted and cannot be read back. Everyone signed in sees their names; only admins change them.

get.description: By name; Viewers see names, Operators also values, Editors change them.

put.description: Creates it (201) or replaces its value (200); names are unique regardless of case. Viewers see names, Operators also values, Editors change them.

get.description: Names only, by name; Viewers see names; Editors change them. Secret values are never returned.

put.description: Creates it (201) or replaces its value (200). The value is encrypted and cannot be read back. Viewers see names; Editors change them.

get.summary: Explain a folder's variables and secrets
get.description: Every name that reaches the folder, each with all its definitions from the instance down and the one that wins. Variable values for Operators; never secret values. Needs Viewer.
Names only, by name; roles of its folder: Viewers see names, Editors change them. Secret values are never returned.

put.description: Creates it (201) or replaces its value (200). The value is encrypted and cannot be read back. Roles of its folder: Viewers see names, Editors change them.

get.summary: Explain an automation's variables and secrets
get.description: Every name a run of the automation reads, each with all its definitions (instance, folders, the automation's secrets and the variables in its file) and the one that wins. Variable values for Operators; never secret values. Needs Viewer.

post.description: Runs the automation's current version. Needs Operator; the automation must allow it (`triggers: manual: true`), and with `concurrency: single` no other run may be active (409).

get.description: Newest first, one page at a time. Needs Viewer.
The newest runs of every automation you may view (Viewer on its folder), one page at a time; `state` keeps only runs in that state.
With its jobs in the order of the automation file. Needs Viewer; also works after the automation was deleted.

get.summary: Get a job of a run
get.description: With its outputs and every attempt with its steps, as far as they got. Needs Viewer.
The chunks after `after` (the start if omitted), at most `limit` (default 100, at most 1000). Read on with `next` until `isComplete`; `missing` lists chunks that never arrived. Needs Viewer.

get.summary: Follow a job attempt's log live
get.description: Server-Sent Events: one `chunk` event per chunk (its `id` is the sequence; reconnecting with `Last-Event-ID` or `after` continues there), then an `end` event once the attempt has finished. Needs Viewer.

post.description: Stops every unfinished job; `finally` jobs with `on_cancel: true` still run. Needs Operator. Cancelling a finished or already cancelled run changes nothing.

get.summary: List a run's test and coverage reports
get.description: Every report file of every job attempt, with its totals or why it could not be read, and totals over each job's latest attempt that uploaded reports. Needs Viewer.

get.summary: Get a report of a run
get.description: Its totals and, for coverage, its packages. Needs Viewer.

get.summary: List the tests of a test report
get.description: In the order of the file, one page at a time; `outcome` (`passed`, `failed`, `skipped`) keeps only those. Needs Viewer.

get.summary: List the classes of a coverage report
get.description: In the order of the file, one page at a time, with the lines no test reached; `package` (a package's `index`) keeps only its classes. Needs Viewer.

get.summary: Get the history of a test
get.description: Its newest results in the automation's runs, by the test's full name (`name`, as `Suite.Name`); at most `limit` (default 50, at most 200). Needs Viewer.
Whether it has one and calls need a signature, without the token. Needs Viewer.

post.description: Replaces any earlier address. The token, and with `requireSignature` the signing secret, are shown only in this response. Calls start runs only while the current version has `triggers: webhook: true`. Needs Operator.

delete.description: Calls of it fail from then on. Needs Operator.

post.description: A one-time token for a runner's register command. The token is in this response only; the server keeps its hash.

get.description: Newest first, used and expired ones included, without their secrets.

delete.description: An unused token can no longer be used. A runner that registered with it stays registered.

get.description: Ordered by name, one page at a time, with what each announced and whether it is online.
The ETag header is the runner's version, for If-Match.

patch.summary: Rename, pause or resume a runner
patch.description: A paused runner stays connected and finishes its jobs but is offered no new ones. Send If-Match with the ETag to avoid overwriting someone else's change (412).

delete.description: Revokes its credential and tells a connected runner not to reconnect. Jobs it still held are offered again or fail, as their retry settings say.

occurredAt.description: When the change was committed, in UTC.

actorId.description: The user behind the change, if any.

actorName.description: The actor's name at the time.

folderId.description: The folder the object lives in.

oneOf.description: A few facts about the change; never secret values.

clientAddress.description: Network address of the client, for changes over HTTP.

userAgent.description: User agent of the client, for changes over HTTP.

AuditEventView.description: An audit entry as the API shows it; fields as described in the audit catalogue.

name.description: The automation's key in its folder.

title.description: `name:` from the file, or the key.

updatedAt.description: When anything about it last changed.

AutomationSummary.description: An automation as listed in its folder.

manual.description: Whether people may start it by hand.

webhook.description: Whether a webhook call may start it.

schedules.description: Its schedule entries with when each fires next.

oneOf.description: The automation whose finished runs start it, if any.

AutomationTriggersView.description: What starts runs of an automation, as its current version says.

valid.description: Whether saving it would be accepted: no errors, only warnings if any.

diagnostics.description: Every error and warning, in the order they appear in the file.

AutomationValidationView.description: What checking a file without saving it found.

number.description: 1 for the first version, counting up.

message.description: What changed, in the author's words.

createdById.description: The author, unless the user has been deleted since.

createdByName.description: The author's user name at the time.

AutomationVersionSummary.description: A saved version as listed in the history.

number.description: 1 for the first version, counting up.

message.description: What changed, in the author's words.

createdById.description: The author, unless the user has been deleted since.

createdByName.description: The author's user name at the time.

yaml.description: The automation file as saved; save it again to restore this version.

AutomationVersionView.description: A saved version with its content.

name.description: The automation's key in its folder.

title.description: `name:` from the file, or the key.

currentVersion.description: Number of the newest version; the ETag of the API.

yaml.description: The automation file of the newest version.

warnings.description: Things in the file that work but deserve a look.

myRole.description: The caller's role on the automation's folder.

updatedAt.description: When anything about it last changed.

AutomationView.description: An automation with the content of its newest version.

newPassword.description: The new password: 12 to 256 characters, not the user name.

ChangePasswordRequest.description: A new password for the signed-in user.

CompletionOutcome.description: Which results of the followed automation start a run (`on`).

automation.description: Its name; `null` while no automation has that name there.

on.description: Which of its results start a run.

name.description: The name as written where it wins.

definitions.description: Every definition in resolution order: instance, folders from the top, automation.

winner.description: The nearest definition, the last of Definitions.

ConfigurationEntry.description: One name, everywhere it is defined, and which definition a run reads.

ConfigurationScopeKind.description: The kinds of places variables and secrets are defined, in the order they resolve.

kind.description: Instance, a folder, or the automation (its secrets, or `variables:` in its file).

value.description: The variable's value, for callers with the Operator role; never set for secrets.

ConfigurationSource.description: One place that defines a name.

variables.description: Every variable name that reaches it.

secrets.description: Every secret name that reaches it, without values.

ConfigurationView.description: What a folder or an automation can read, and from where; never a secret value.

index.description: Its position in the report, from 0.

package.description: The int CoveragePackageView.Index of its package.

name.description: The class name as the tool reports it.

uncovered.description: Lines no test reached, such as `10-11,19,45`.

CoverageClassView.description: Coverage of a class, or of a file in languages without classes.

index.description: Its position in the report, from 0; classes name their package by it.

name.description: The package name as the tool reports it.

coverage.description: Its lines and branches, including classes cut from the details.

CoveragePackageView.description: Coverage of a package: an assembly (.NET), a directory (Python, JavaScript) or a Java package.

lineRate.description: Share of lines covered, from 0 to 1; `null` without lines.

branchRate.description: Share of branches covered, from 0 to 1; `null` without branches.

CoverageTotalsView.description: Covered and coverable lines and branches.

name.description: The key in the folder, like a file name: 1 to 100 characters, no slash; unique in the folder regardless of case.

yaml.description: The automation file; it must be valid, else the problem lists every diagnostic.

message.description: What this first version is, in your words.

CreateAutomationRequest.description: An automation to create in a folder.

token.description: The secret to pass to the runner's `register` command.

details.description: The token as it will be listed.

CreatedRegistrationToken.description: A new runner registration token. string CreatedRegistrationToken.Token is shown this once.

token.description: The secret to send as `Authorization: Bearer …`.

details.description: The token as it will be listed.

CreatedToken.description: A new API token. string CreatedToken.Token is shown this once and cannot be retrieved again.

path.description: The path to call with POST, such as `/api/v1/hooks/ach_…`.

signingSecret.description: The secret calls are signed with; `null` for unsigned calls.

hint.description: The token's start and end, as shown later.

enabled.description: Whether the current version allows webhook calls yet.

CreatedWebhookView.description: A new webhook address; the token and the signing secret are shown only now.

name.description: The name: 1 to 100 characters, no slash; unique among its siblings regardless of case.

parentId.description: The folder to create it in (needs Editor there); omitted or null for the top level, where the creator becomes Owner.

name.description: The group name; unique regardless of case.

description.description: What the token is for, such as the machine the runner will run on.

expiresAt.description: When the token stops working if unused; at most 30 days away. Default: in 24 hours.

CreateRegistrationTokenRequest.description: A runner registration token to create.

name.description: What the token is for, e.g. the script or machine using it.

expiresAt.description: When the token stops working; never if omitted.

CreateTokenRequest.description: An API token to create for the signed-in user.

userName.description: The name to sign in with: letters, digits, dot, underscore, hyphen; unique regardless of case.

displayName.description: The name shown to other people; defaults to the user name.

isAdmin.description: Whether the user administers the instance.

CreateUserRequest.description: A user to create. The user must change the password at the first sign-in.

requireSignature.description: Whether calls must be signed with a secret the server makes; false by default.

severity.description: Errors keep the file from being saved; warnings do not.

code.description: Stable identifier such as `AC0103`; the user guide explains each one.

message.description: What is wrong and how to fix it.

path.description: Where in the document, such as `jobs.build.needs[0]`; empty for the whole file.

line.description: 1-based line in the file, when the problem can be pinned to one.

column.description: 1-based column in the file, when the problem can be pinned to one.

DiagnosticView.description: A problem in an automation file, as the API reports it.

users.description: Users that are not disabled, without their e-mail addresses.

DirectoryView.description: People and groups found by a search, names whose start matches first.

id.description: The folder's id, or `null` when the caller may not open it.

FolderCrumb.description: A folder above the current one, for orientation.

FolderRole.description:
Roles on a folder (ADR-0012), each including the ones before it. The numeric order is the
order of power; the database stores the names.

isRestricted.description: Whether grants from above stop applying here.

myRole.description: The caller's role on this folder.

FolderSummary.description: A subfolder as listed under its parent.

parentId.description: The folder above; `null` at the top level.

isRestricted.description: Whether grants from above stop applying here.

path.description: The folders above, from the top level down (names; ids only where the caller may open them).

myRole.description: The caller's role on this folder.

version.description: Changes with every change of the folder; the ETag of the API.

FolderView.description: A folder as the caller sees it.

subjectName.description: The user name or group name.

createdAt.description: When the grant was first made.

GrantView.description: A role granted directly on a folder.

GroupDetails.description: A group with its members, ordered by user name.

GroupSummary.description: A group as shown in a user's memberships.

memberCount.description: How many users are in it.

id.description: The attempt's id; its log is read by it.

exitCode.description: Exit code of a script step.

startedAt.description: When it started, by the runner's clock.

finishedAt.description: When it ended, by the runner's clock.

JobStepView.description: A step of a job attempt, as far as it got.

sequence.description: Its position in the log; numbers that are missing were never received.

stepIndex.description: The step that wrote it; `null` for preparation and cleanup.

LogChunkView.description: A chunk of a job's log.

time.description: When it was written, by the runner's clock.

source.description: Where it came from: standard output, standard error or the runner itself.

text.description: The text without its line ending, masked.

LogLine.description: One line of a job's log.

chunks.description: The chunks after the requested sequence, in order.

next.description: Pass as `after` to read on; the last sequence returned, or the requested one.

missing.description: Sequences before the last one returned that never arrived (at most 100).

isTruncated.description: The log reached its limit and later lines were dropped.

LogPage.description: A part of a job attempt's log.

LogSource.description: Where a log line came from.

groups.description: The groups the user is in, ordered by name.

MeView.description: The signed-in user's own account with their groups.

folderId.description: The folder to move it to; needs Editor there as well as on the current folder.

parentId.description: The new parent (needs Editor there), or null for the top level (needs Owner of the folder).

index.description: Its position in the report, from 0.

group.description: Assembly (TRX) or enclosing suite (JUnit), when the format says.

durationMs.description: How long it ran, in milliseconds.

output.description: What it wrote to standard output and error.

TestCaseView.description: One test of a test report.

runNumber.description: The run's number in its automation.

reportId.description: The report the result is in.

durationMs.description: How long it ran, in milliseconds.

message.description: Why it failed or was skipped.

TestHistoryEntry.description: One result of a test in a run.

passed.description: How often it passed among Entries.

failed.description: How often it failed among them.

skipped.description: How often it did not run among them.

entries.description: Its results, newest first; a test reported twice in one attempt appears twice.

name.description: What the token is used for.

isExpired.description: Whether the token no longer works because it expired.

description.description: A new description; an empty string removes it.

description.description: A new description; an empty string removes it.

UpdateGroupRequest.description: Changes to a group; omitted properties stay as they are.

name.description: A new display name, unique regardless of case.

email.description: A new contact address; an empty string removes it.

isAdmin.description: Grant or take away instance administration.

isDisabled.description: Block or unblock the user; blocking signs them out everywhere.

userName.description: The name used to sign in.

displayName.description: The name shown to other people.

UserSummary.description: A user as shown in member lists.

displayName.description: The name shown to other people.

isAdmin.description: Whether the user administers the instance.

mustChangePassword.description: Whether the user has to replace a password someone else set.

lastSignInAt.description: The last successful sign-in, if any.

UserView.description: A user as administrators and the user themselves see it; never the password hash.

folderId.description: The folder it would be saved in; its triggers are checked from there.

automationId.description: The automation being edited, if any; it must be in that folder.

VariableView.description: A variable as listed in its scope.

enabled.description: Whether the current version allows webhook calls (`triggers.webhook: true`); calls fail without it.

hint.description: The token's start and end; `null` while there is no address.
